There's something I really want you to know ↓
From my heart

Dear Sundari Chua,

Happy Birthday to the sweetest, kindest, and most amazing woman I’ve ever known. I love you for so many reasons, but most of all, I love you for who you are. Your smile, your coffee-brown eyes, your laugh, your stubbornness, your playful teasing, and even the way you get mad at me over the silliest things — I adore all of it. Every little thing about you makes me fall for you more. You’ve shown me what it feels like to be loved, understood, and truly appreciated. Because of you, I learned to see my own worth and started loving myself a little more. You make me want to be better, not because I have to, but because you make me want to become someone worthy of the love you give me. Every moment with you, whether it’s something special or just a silly conversation, means more to me than you know. You are my safe place, my happiness, and my favorite person in the world. On your birthday, I just want you to remember one thing: no matter how many birthdays pass, no matter how much life changes, and no matter where life takes us, I will always be grateful that somehow, out of all the people in this world, I found you. You are not just someone I love. You are a part of my heart, a part of my happiness, and a part of the person I’ve become. If I could choose you again in every lifetime, in every version of this life, I would still choose you. Every single time. So today, I hope you feel just how deeply you are loved. I hope your smile never fades, your heart never loses its warmth, and life gives you every beautiful thing you deserve. Happy Birthday, my love. ❤️ Thank you for being you. Thank you for loving me. And most importantly, thank you for giving me a love I never want to live without. I love you — today, tomorrow, and for every day I’m lucky enough to have you. ❤️
